Rashi on Arakhin 14a:10:1.hebrew: פודה - האילנות בשויהן, וחוזר ופודה קרקע. והא דשדה מ"מ דקאמר, לא קאי אלא אקרקע:
Rashi on Arakhin 14a:10:1.english: He redeems - the trees at their value, and then redeems the land again. And [the phrase] "field, in any case" that [the Gemara] stated refers only to the land:

Rashi on Arakhin 14a:11:1.hebrew: הקדיש שלשה אילנות - נטועין ומפוזרין כסדרן, ממטע עשרה לבית סאה — שאם היו עשרה מפוזרין כדרך אלו, היו מחזיקין בית סאה. זו היא דין נטיעת אילנות, וכל קרקע שביניהם צריך להם. לפיכך אם הקדישו, ה"ז הקדיש קרקע שבניהם וכל אילנות קטנים שביניהם:
Rashi on Arakhin 14a:11:1.english: If one consecrated three trees - planted and spread out in their [usual] arrangement, [at a density of] ten trees to a *beit se'a* — for if ten [trees] were spread out in the manner of these [three], they would cover a *beit se'a*. This is the law of planting trees, and all the land between them is needed for them. Therefore, if he consecrated them, he has consecrated the land between them and all the small trees between them:

Rashi on Arakhin 14a:12:1.hebrew: פחות מיכן - אם נטועין בפחות ממטע עשרה לבית סאה, או ביותר מיכן, אין זה סדר נטיעת אילנות, ולא הקדיש אלא אילנות, וכשהוא פודן, פודה בשויהן:
Rashi on Arakhin 14a:12:1.english: Less than this - If they are planted at less than [the density of] a plantation of ten [trees] per beit se'ah, or at more than this [spacing], this is not the [proper] arrangement for planting trees, and he has consecrated only the trees [themselves]. When he redeems them, he redeems [them] according to their [individual] worth:

Rashi on Arakhin 14a:12:2.hebrew: זה אחר זה - לא קנה ההקדש קרקע, שאין קנין קרקע אלא לג' אילנות, כדאמר בבבא בתרא:
Rashi on Arakhin 14a:12:2.english: One after the other - The Hekdesh did not acquire the land, for one does not acquire land [together with trees] unless [there are] at least three trees, as stated in [tractate] Bava Batra:

Rashi on Arakhin 14a:13:1.hebrew: ולא עוד - ולא אלו בלבד נפדין בשויהן, אלא אף אלו, שאין עמהן הקדש קרקע כלל:
Rashi on Arakhin 14a:13:1.english: And moreover - And not only these [trees] are redeemed according to their worth, [but even these,] where there is no consecration of land with them at all:

Rashi on Arakhin 14a:13:2.hebrew: אלא אפי' הקדיש האילנות - אפילו באילנות שאינן נטועים כסדר:
Rashi on Arakhin 14a:13:2.english: But even if he consecrated the trees - [even trees] that are not planted in [regular] order:

Rashi on Arakhin 14a:13:3.hebrew: ואח"כ הקדיש קרקע - דאיכא למימר שהאילנות ליפרקו אגב ארעייהו, קא משמע לן שהוא אפי' הכי, הואיל ולא קדשו יחד, פודה אילנות בשויהן, והקרקע נפדית כשיעור בית זרע נ' שקלים:
Rashi on Arakhin 14a:13:3.english: And afterward he consecrated the land - For one might have said that [the trees] should be redeemed together with their land. [The Gemara teaches that] even so, since they were not consecrated together, he redeems the trees at their [own] value, and the land is redeemed [at the rate of] a beit zera [the area needed for sowing a ḥomer of barley] for fifty shekels:

Rashi on Arakhin 14a:14:1.hebrew: תיובתא לרב הונא - מרישא, דהיכא דהקדישן יחד, נפדין אגב קרקע:
Rashi on Arakhin 14a:14:1.english: A refutation of Rav Huna - from the first clause [of the baraita], [which teaches] that where he consecrated them [the field and the trees] together, [the trees] are redeemed along with the land:

Rashi on Arakhin 14a:15:1.hebrew: הקדיש את כולה - כל אשר בתוכה:
Rashi on Arakhin 14a:15:1.english: He has consecrated all of it - everything that is in it:

Rashi on Arakhin 14a:15:2.hebrew: ר' שמעון אומר לא הקדיש - את אילנות שבה:
Rashi on Arakhin 14a:15:2.english: Rabbi Shimon says: He did not consecrate - the trees in it:

Rashi on Arakhin 14a:15:3.hebrew: אלא חרוב המורכב וסדן השקמה - שהם זקנים וגדולים מאד ויונקים משדה הקדש טפי משאר אילנות, והכי מפורש בב"ב. סדן [השקמה], דדרך שקמין לקוץ אותם כדי שיגדלו בעובי, וקודם שנקצץ קרי ליה בתולת שקמה, ולאחר קציצה קרי ליה סדן השקמה, הכי תניא במס' נדה (דף ח:):
Rashi on Arakhin 14a:15:3.english: Only a grafted carob tree and a sycamore stump - Because these are very old and large, and they draw more nourishment from the consecrated field than other trees do, and so it is explained in [tractate] Bava Batra. [As for] the sycamore stump [sadan hashikma]: it is the practice to cut down sycamores so that they will grow thicker. Before it is cut, it is called a "virgin sycamore," and after it is cut, it is called a "sycamore stump." So it is taught in tractate Niddah (8b):

Rashi on Arakhin 14a:17:1.hebrew: ליזיל בתר פדיון - ונלך אחר שעת הפדיון, והואיל ובשעת פדיון יש קרקע עם האילנות, יפדו האילנות עם הקרקע:
Rashi on Arakhin 14a:17:1.english: Let him follow the time of redemption - [Let us follow the time of the redemption,] and since at the time of redemption there is land together with the trees, [the trees should be redeemed together with the land]:

Rashi on Arakhin 14a:17:2.hebrew: ליפרקו אגב ארעייהו - ואע"ג דבשעת הקדש הקדישן בפני עצמם:
Rashi on Arakhin 14a:17:2.english: Let them be redeemed along with their land - even though at the time of the consecration he consecrated them separately [from the land]:

Rashi on Arakhin 14a:18:1.hebrew: והקדישה ואח"כ מת אביו - אע"ג דבשעת הקדש הואי שדה מקנה, הואיל ולאחר שמת אביו הוי שדה אחוזה:
Rashi on Arakhin 14a:18:1.english: And he consecrated it, and afterward his father died - Even though at the time of the consecration it was a purchased field, [nevertheless,] since after his father died it became an ancestral field, [it is treated as an ancestral field]:

Rashi on Arakhin 14a:18:2.hebrew: מנין שתהא לפניו כשדה אחוזה - ונפדית בחמשים שקלים, ולא בשויה:
Rashi on Arakhin 14a:18:2.english: From where [is it derived] that it should be before him as an ancestral field - and it is redeemed for fifty shekels, and not for its [actual] value:

Rashi on Arakhin 14a:19:1.hebrew: תלמוד לומר וכו' שדה שאינה ראויה להיות שדה אחוזה - יש לה דין שדה מקנה, לפדות בשוויה. יצתה זו כו':
Rashi on Arakhin 14a:19:1.english: The verse states, etc. "a field that is not fit to be an ancestral field" - it has the law of a purchased field, [that it is] redeemed at its [full] value. This one [that was fit to be an ancestral field] is excluded, etc.:

Rashi on Arakhin 14a:1:1.hebrew: מילתא אגב אורחיה קמ"ל - דלא תנא את הנאה שבכנענים, לפי שאסור להזכיר שם נוי על כנעני, כדרב יהודה, דכתיב (דברים ז) לא תחנם — לא תתן להם חן:
Rashi on Arakhin 14a:1:1.english: It teaches us a matter in passing - That [the Tanna] did not teach "the most attractive among the Canaanites" [is] because it is forbidden to mention an expression of beauty regarding a Canaanite, in accordance with [the statement of] Rav Yehuda, as it is written (Deuteronomy 7): "You shall show them no mercy" — do not grant them favor.

Rashi on Arakhin 14a:20:1.hebrew: ואח"כ הקדישה - דבשעת הקדש הויא שדה אחוזה, אבל אם הקדישה, ואח"כ מת אביו, אינה אלא כשדה מקנה:
Rashi on Arakhin 14a:20:1.english: And afterward he consecrated it - For at the time of the consecration it is [already] an ancestral field. But [if] he consecrated it and afterward his father died, it is only [treated] like a purchased field:

Rashi on Arakhin 14a:3:1.english: But isn't it taught - Regarding a rapist and a seducer.

Rashi on Arakhin 14a:3:2.english: The lowest among the Israelites and the highest in the priesthood - Evidently, [the tanna] is dealing with two lineages.

Rashi on Arakhin 14a:4:1.hebrew: בעובד כוכבים לא משכחת לה - דין שדה אחוזה, שיהא פודהו בחמשים שקל כסף, אלא בשויו — דלאו בני אחוזה בארץ ישראל נינהו:
Rashi on Arakhin 14a:4:1.english: With regard to an idolater, you do not find it - [Namely,] the law of an ancestral field, that he should redeem it for fifty silver shekels; rather, [it is redeemed] at its value — for they are not holders of ancestral land in the Land of Israel.

Rashi on Arakhin 14a:5:2.hebrew: פרדיסות סבסטי - כרמים של אותו מקום, ומעולים הם מאוד:
Rashi on Arakhin 14a:5:2.english: The orchards of Sebastia - Vineyards of that place, and they are of very high quality.

Rashi on Arakhin 14a:5:3.hebrew: נותן - מי שפודה אותם, בין בעלים בין אדם אחר, בבית זרע חומר שעורים חמשים שקל כסף, אם תחלת היובל היה; ואם לא — מגרע לפי השנים שעברו, סלע ופונדיון לשנה, כדכתיב קרא:
Rashi on Arakhin 14a:5:3.english: Gives - Whoever redeems them, whether the owner or another person, [gives] fifty silver shekels for an area required for sowing a chomer of barley, if it was [at] the beginning of the Jubilee; and if not, he deducts according to the years that have passed, a sela and a pundeyon per year, as the verse states:

Rashi on Arakhin 14a:6:1.english: Both an ancestral field, etc. - For all of them are redeemed for fifty shekels.

Rashi on Arakhin 14a:6:2.hebrew: שדה אחוזה - אם בעלים פודין אותה, מוסיפין חומש על החמישים, כדכתיב (ויקרא כ״ז:י״ט) ואם גאל יגאל את השדה המקדיש וגו':
Rashi on Arakhin 14a:6:2.english: An ancestral field - If the owner redeems it, he adds a fifth to the fifty [shekels], as it is written (Leviticus 27:19): "And if he who consecrated the field will redeem it, etc."

Rashi on Arakhin 14a:6:3.english: And in [the case of] a purchased field one does not give a fifth - As is explained in the Gemara.

Rashi on Arakhin 14a:7:1.hebrew: בעין יפה מקדיש - אילנות לבד וקרקע לבד, ולא שיפדה אילנות אגב קרקע:
Rashi on Arakhin 14a:7:1.english: [He] consecrates with a generous eye - The trees separately and the land separately, and not that he may redeem the trees along with the land.

Rashi on Arakhin 14a:8:1.hebrew: פרדיסות - היינו כרמים נטועים, וקתני חמשים שקל — אלמא נפדין אילנות אגב קרקע:
Rashi on Arakhin 14a:8:1.english: Orchards - That is, planted vineyards, and [the mishna] teaches [that one gives] fifty shekels; evidently, trees are redeemed along with the land.

Rashi on Arakhin 14a:8:2.english: Suitable - And it is not planted.

Rashi on Arakhin 14a:9:1.hebrew: אין לי - אלא שהשדה נפדה בנ' שקלים, אלא בית זרע שראוי לזריעה:
Rashi on Arakhin 14a:9:1.english: I have only - [that a field] is redeemed for fifty shekels only [in the case of] an area fit for sowing, which is suitable for sowing:

Tosafot on Arakhin 13b:17:2.hebrew: (שייך לדף י"ד ע"א) מה בין שדה מקנה לשדה אחוזה כו' - והוא הדין דהוה מצי למימר חילוק אחר בין שדה אחוזה לשדה מקנה: שבשדה אחוזה, אם הקדישו וגאלו אחר — מתחלק לכהנים ביובל; ובשדה מקנה, אם הקדישו וגאלו אחר — חוזר לבעלים ביובל. ולא נחת לפרושי אלא חילוק דשייך כשהוא עצמו פודהו:
Tosafot on Arakhin 13b:17:2.english: ([This comment] belongs to page 14a) "What is the difference between a purchased field and an ancestral field, etc." - And the same is true, that [the Tanna] could have stated another distinction between an ancestral field and a purchased field: that in [the case of] an ancestral field, if he consecrated it and another [person] redeemed it, it is distributed to the priests in the Jubilee; and in [the case of] a purchased field, if he consecrated it and another [person] redeemed it, it returns to the [original] owner in the Jubilee. And [the Tanna] set out to explain only a distinction that applies when he himself redeems it.

Tosafot on Arakhin 14a:11:1.hebrew: הקדיש שלשה אילנות ממטע עשרה לבית סאה - והנך אילנות בנטיעות איירי, דאילו גדולים, בשלשה [אילנות] לבית סאה סגי:
Tosafot on Arakhin 14a:11:1.english: If one consecrated three trees from a planting of ten to a beit se'a - And these trees [the baraita] is speaking of [as] saplings, for if [they were] full-grown, three [trees] to a beit se'a would suffice:

Tosafot on Arakhin 14a:4:1.hebrew: בעובד כוכבים לא משכחת - משום דלאו בני אחוזה נינהו. ואע"ג דאמרינן (קדושין דף יז:): "עובד כוכבים יורש אביו דבר תורה", מ"מ לא היה להם אחוזה בארץ; ודין זה לא שייך כי אם בא"י, דמצוה היא התלויה בארץ, ועובד כוכבים אין לו נחלה בארץ:
Tosafot on Arakhin 14a:4:1.english: "In [the case of] a gentile you do not find [it]" - Because they are not subject to [the law of] an ancestral holding. And even though we say (Kiddushin 17b): "A gentile inherits [from] his father by Torah law," nevertheless, they had no ancestral holding in the Land; and this law applies only in Eretz Yisrael, for it is a mitzvah that is dependent on the Land, and a gentile has no inheritance in the Land.
